title: The stack
logline: The mill's stack from the road in 1994, smoking, the last month. Drawn in the Era I manner on purpose: heavy black spotting, the smoke a solid shape. The town's clock, before the strip.

panels.composition: The cedar mill's brick stack from the beach road, smoking, the yard's log decks below it, a pickup on the road, the ridge behind. Era I's black spotting: the smoke a solid black shape.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a tall brick mill stack smoking above stacked log decks seen from a coastal road with a pickup passing and a wooded ridge behind, the smoke a solid black shape, no words
image.notes: Era I spotting inside an era4 page: the sequence's rule.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The stack, working. Before the strip.
